title: New People Movement - Promoted By The Nanking Government

page_data.en:
（印：1401 27 / 42）
January 24, 1942.

"New People Movement" promoted
by the Nanking Government

In view of the change in the Far Eastern situation
following the outbreak of the Pacific War and in order
to accelerate the establishment of the "New Order in the
Orient", Mr. Wang Ching-wei, Chairman of the Nanking
Government, is promoting a "New People Movement", the
general principles of which were issued on January 1,
1942. This movement has the fundamental principles of
the "New Life Movement" and the "Spiritual Mobilization
Movement" promoted by the Chungking Government, and the
"Sino-Japanese Rapprochement Pact".

During a meeting held on January 16, 1942, the
Nanking Government decided on the following plans for
the enforcement of the movement :-
(1) That the enforcement of the movement be completed
within three periods as follows :-
(a) During the first period, extensive propaganda
work will be carried out to acquaint the
people with the significance of the movement.
(b) During the second period, youths will be
selected from schools, organizations etc.
to undergo civic training. Detailed plans
will be discussed later.
(c) During the third period, the trained youths will
be detailed to train the people in general.
Detailed plans will be discussed later.

page_data.zh:
（印：1401 27 / 42）
1942年1月24日。

南京政府推行“新民运动”

鉴于太平洋战争爆发后远东局势的变化，并为加速建立“东方新秩序”，南京政府主席汪精卫先生正在推行一项“新民运动”，其总纲已于1942年1月1日发布。该运动以重庆政府推行的“新生活运动”和“精神总动员运动”之基本原则，以及《中日亲善公约》为基础。

在1942年1月16日举行的一次会议上，南京政府决定了实施该运动的以下计划：
(1) 该运动的实施将分三个阶段完成，具体如下：
(a) 第一阶段，开展广泛的宣传工作，使民众了解该运动的意义。
(b) 第二阶段，从学校、团体等机构中选拔青年接受公民训练。详细计划稍后讨论。
(c) 第三阶段，受训青年将被派往各处训练普通民众。详细计划稍后讨论。
(2) 第一阶段（1942年1月21日至2月2日）的宣传工作安排如下：
(a) 各学校及大专院校将由教育部指令讲授“新民运动”的原则，教育部与宣传部将派遣官员前往各学校及大专院校发表与该运动有关的演讲。

（批：D.C.B.S.B. / Hole少校 / 1942年1月24日 / 等）

Ministry of Education to give lessons on the
principles of the "New People Movement", and
the Ministry of Education and the Ministry
of Publicity will send officers to schools
and colleges to deliver lectures relating
to the movement.
(b) Newspapers and other publications will
publish special issues once a week to propagate
the movement.
(c) Newspapers will endeavour to collect the opinions
of the public regarding the movement for
consideration when the plans for the second are
discussed.
(d) Booklets, posters and pictorials will be
distributed, lectures given, and theatrical
performances staged to propagate the movement.
(e) The people, in groups, will take oath to join
the movement.
(f) Prizes will be offered for composing songs and
plays bearing on the movement.
(g) Further propaganda will be carried out by
sending postcards, flying balloons, and
broadcasts over radio stations. Advantage
will be taken of the occassion to reveal the
atrocities of guerilla units.

(b) 报纸及其他出版物将每周出版特刊一次，以宣传该运动。
(c) 报纸将努力收集公众对该运动的意见，供讨论第二阶段计划时参考。
(d) 分发小册子、海报和画报，举办讲座，并上演戏剧以宣传该运动。
(e) 民众将分组宣誓加入该运动。
(f) 设立奖项，征集与该运动相关的歌曲和剧本。
(g) 通过寄送明信片、放飞气球以及广播电台广播等方式开展进一步宣传。并将借此机会揭露游击队的暴行。
